statement: Complete executed finite-subgroup and full partial-section catalogues for punctured spheres with 3,4,5,6 punctures: respectively 10,30,20,57 conjugacy classes; exact finite decorated-orbifold parameterization and all stabilizers, multipliers, centralizers and incidences.
where_proved: work/part_b/b26.tex; work/part_b/code/catalogue_spheres.py and its four CSV/JSON catalogues
manuscript_passages: Part B(f) of the task; no further manuscript assertion
notes: All spherical types in the requested hyperbolic range are now covered. Exhaustiveness uses positive orbifold Euler characteristic, proved bounds n<=nu and decorated universal orbifold covers. The program checks presentation/local injection/Euler characteristic certificates and independently reproduces B.23 and B.25 invariants for nu=3,4. This does not claim the remaining punctured torus or higher-genus cases.
